hints.title: Leverage Sorted Rows
hints.text: Since each row is sorted in strictly increasing order, pick candidates from the first row and verify presence in subsequent rows.

hints.title: Binary Search per Row
hints.text: For each element in row zero, perform binary search across rows one through m - 1.

hints.title: Return on First Complete Match
hints.text: Because row zero is already sorted ascending, the first element found in every row is guaranteed to be the smallest.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Linear search across every row for every candidate incurs O(M * N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Binary search inside sorted rows uses O(1) auxiliary space without requiring auxiliary frequency arrays.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should notice that testing row zero elements in order ensures finding the minimum common element immediately.
complexity.notes: Elements in each row are strictly increasing.
